anomalies.observed: On the CAN BUS sheet, the isolated CAN transceivers U11 and U10 have their primary-side ground pins (GND1, pin 4) and secondary-side ground pins (GND2, pin 5) both connected to the same global GND symbol.
anomalies.expected: The specification states that the board implements "two isolated CAN buses" through "an isolated CAN transceiver". Standard use of an isolated CAN transceiver requires the logic-side and bus-side grounds to remain separate; tying GND1 and GND2 together defeats the galvanic isolation.

evidence.quote: two isolated CAN buses (`CAN0`, `CAN1`), each driven by its own MCP2515 SPI CAN controller (`U8`, `U9`) through an isolated CAN transceiver (`U11`/companion)
CAN BUS sheet: U11 pins 4 GND1 and 5 GND2 connect to GND; U10 pins 4 GND1 and 5 GND2 connect to GND

anomalies.impact: The CAN interfaces are no longer galvanically isolated from the main board ground, allowing ground loops and noise coupling and removing the intended isolation protection.

parsed.summary: The main deviation found is that the isolated CAN transceivers U10 and U11 have both of their isolated ground domains tied to the same GND net, contradicting the specification's intended isolated CAN buses.
